assembly_notes: Install the lens and sensor, ejector/exposure engine, flash, switches, and battery pack to the main PCB per the design sequence; route and secure interconnects clear of moving parts.
Join the top and bottom shells, verify mating alignment, then tighten M2.5 screws evenly without stripping the molded bosses.
Perform powered functional testing of imaging, exposure, flash, controls, and film ejection; burn in the assembled electronics and verify battery charging and protection.
Protect battery terminals against short circuits and ship the Li-ion battery by sea only as UN3481 packed with equipment.
